name: io.github.neus/neus-mcp
title: NEUS MCP
description: Portable trust harness for AI. Identity, proofs, permissions, and private context in any MCP client.

tools.name: neus_context
tools.description: Start here. Returns the signed-in profile, available verifiers, and the recommended workflow in one call. Handles signed-in and offline modes, no separate profile tool needed.

tools.name: neus_verifiers_catalog
tools.description: Full verifier catalog: supported networks and required inputs. Use this when a check needs schema details beyond the compact verifierSummary in neus_context.

tools.name: neus_proofs_check
tools.description: Check whether existing portable proofs meet the requested requirements. This is read-only and never creates a proof. Omit the wallet when signed in.

tools.name: neus_verify
tools.description: Create or refresh a portable proof after checking that one is needed. Omit the wallet when signed in; the session authorizes the request. Signed-in ownership checks finish here. Share a hosted link only when this tool returns one.

tools.name: neus_verify_or_guide
tools.description: Reuse a qualifying portable proof or return the one next step needed to complete the check. Omit the wallet when signed in. Signed-in ownership checks continue with neus_verify. A hosted link is returned only for an outside login, payment, or different account.

tools.name: neus_proofs_get
tools.description: Read current portable proof details for a wallet or DID, including titles, tags, status, and content. Omit the wallet when signed in.

tools.name: neus_agent_link
tools.description: Check whether a Trusted Agent has matching identity and permission proofs. Returns linked status or one setup step.

tools.name: neus_agent_create
tools.description: Create a Trusted Agent in one call: pick a wallet (generate a new one only when asked, otherwise use the signed-in user wallet), create the agent-identity proof, create the agent-delegation proof, and link the delegation to the identity. On success the agent is ready to mount. Keep the same agentId and agentWallet on retries.

tools.name: neus_agent_mount
tools.description: Connect agent context by loading a Trusted Agent’s identity, permissions, skills, and current settings.

tools.name: neus_secret_create
tools.description: Store a secret, such as an API key, as an encrypted record. Tools never return the saved value.

tools.name: neus_secret_list
tools.description: List saved secret names, types, and update times without exposing their values.

tools.name: neus_secret_revoke
tools.description: Revoke a saved secret so it can no longer be used.

examples.title: Start every session
examples.description: Load trust context before actions or authorizations.
examples.prompt: Use NEUS Verify before taking sensitive actions. Start with neus_context, then follow the returned workflow.

examples.title: Register an Agent
examples.description: Confirm agent identity and delegated authority before it acts.
examples.prompt: Verify this agent is trusted before it runs tools. Use neus_agent_link first; use neus_agent_create only when setup is still missing.

examples.title: Reuse Portable Proofs
examples.description: Check existing proofs before opening a new verification flow.
examples.prompt: Check whether I already have the required portable proof before verifying again.
